# Vendored HTML parser dependencies

These packages are used only to parse public HTML into an inert document tree. No page scripts are evaluated. Package install scripts were not run.

- **parse5 7.3.0**, MIT. Official package: https://registry.npmjs.org/parse5/7.3.0. Documentation: https://parse5.js.org/. License retained in `node_modules/parse5/LICENSE`.
- **entities 6.0.1**, BSD-2-Clause, dependency of parse5. Official package: https://registry.npmjs.org/entities/6.0.1. License retained in `node_modules/entities/LICENSE`.

Both archives were downloaded from the official npm registry and their SHA-512 digests were verified against the registry `dist.integrity` metadata before extraction. They are bundled with the application; no npm or system installation is needed.
